Package dev.opencollab.paletter.item.component

Interface ColorValue

All Known Implementing Classes:
ColorValue.Channels, ColorValue.Hex
public sealed interface ColorValue permits ColorValue.Channels, ColorValue.Hex
The value of an add-on JSON field that takes one of several forms:
  • ColorValue.Channels: the red, green and blue channels
  • ColorValue.Hex: a hex color of six digits

Switch over it without a default: the records below are all its forms.

Used by: item:minecraft:dyeable:default_color.
